Biallelic CDC20 Variants Reducing APC/C Co-activator Function

nodes.description: Homozygous missense variants and compound-heterozygous combinations of a missense variant with a nonsense, frameshift, or splice allele reduce CDC20 mRNA or protein. Truncating alleles fail to localize to kinetochores, and every tested genotype rescued first-polar-body extrusion less well than wild-type CDC20. CDC20 normally binds the APC/C and activates its ubiquitin ligase activity toward cyclin B1 and securin. The genotypes are treated as partial rather than complete loss of function because Cdc20 knockout is embryonic lethal in mice, whereas affected women have no somatic phenotype.
